When the first-list head at this+0x100 is non-null, walks each node's sub-list (sub-list head at node+236, forward links at +76), advancing to the next first-list node through the +260 link when a sub-list runs out. When the first list is empty or exhausted, falls back to a second list headed at this+0x108, walking +76 forward links. Returns the node at index a2, or 0 when the index exceeds the reachable node count.
